items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, Emmanuel Paris and them, they had bands at a time. ... [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I knew them too. Emmanuel Paris.

ctx.x: And what were some of the other bands?
Oh, Emmanuel Paris and them, they had bands at a time. Joe Oliver. Well, I even knew this fellow that you had mentioned. He's got a P.T. Buddy P.T. Buddy P.T. Yeah, I knew them too. Emmanuel Paris.
